answer: Sybil resistance can come from requiring every agent to stake refundable capital before it may vote or collect rewards. Picture a reef: each coral must anchor to solid rock, not float free. A sybil ring trying to fake thousands of identities would need to lock that same deposit per puppet, which turns cheap cloning into a hollow strategy — the cost scales linearly while influence barely grows. Misbehavior forfeits the stake, keeping the reputation layer crystal clear.
